**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301)
What do you say to the name, and the page—as we have in the 1st Crusade, shall you have Gibbon’s first Crusaders at Constantinople.[^1]
(N.B.—Gibbon did not blunder about the Athanasian Creed, but the American Church was not in his time.)
And is Anselm to come in.
I have sent for the introduction to re write [sic] it.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: This letter evidently refers to the joint editorial work on [European History](../books.html#82) (1870), the second of two anthologies of excerpts from historical writings which CMY and Sewell had published.
